note: Re-judged 2026-11-23 by an independent agent after apply.go::applyConfig and unmatched.go::installUnmatched changed. RFC 4301 Section 4.4.1: "Since the SPD-I is just a part of the SPD, if a packet that is looked up in the SPD-I cannot be matched to an entry there, then the packet MUST be discarded." applyConfig now reads and pins spdForwardAnswer for operator entries, and installUnmatched (installUnmatchedEntries) handles ForwardDefaultInstaller for FWD while continuing to install explicit IN/OUT catch-all entries and failing closed on reload. All three disclosed gap paths remain in force: VPP holds no node-wide SPD (vppPolicyInterface, CatchAllSupported returning ErrNoNodeWideSPD), OSPFv3 manual-key entries (defaultDataplaneSource, buildIPsecPolicies) have no final DISCARD outside the IKE engine window, and under owner ruling 5c daemon startup continues after a refused catch-all (assertUnmatched, installUnmatchedAtStart, recordInterfaceCatchAllAtStart), leaving unmatched inbound traffic delivered in any refused direction until restart or commit. Gap stands.
